items.title: Limits of constructibly closed subsets of spectral spaces are quasi-compact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a limit of constructibly closed subsets of spectral spaces compatible with spectral transition maps is quasi-compact, and hence that the limit of the spectral spaces themselves is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 4995-5006, label lemma-inverse-limit-spectral-spaces-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 5008-5024) passes to the constructible topologies where the restricted system consists of quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces, applies the space-level quasi-compactness of limits and transfers the conclusion along the continuous bijection (proof lines 5008-5023). The change of topology and the transfer are the substance. H3.
